name: Oh My Pi (omp)
tagline: Terminal coding agent forked from Pi, with subagents, worktree isolation and code review.
description: A fork of Pi by Stencil Labs that adds first-class subagents, parallel worktree-isolated task fan-out, a plan mode, LSP/DAP tooling, and a review command that ranks findings by priority. It runs as a single binary on macOS, Linux and Windows with 60+ model providers.

pricing.notes: Open source under MIT; you supply provider access through subscriptions, API keys or local models.
